description: Administrative interfaces accessible to unauthorized users or the public internet.
impact: Attackers can brute-force credentials, exploit unpatched flaws, or leverage default passwords to gain full control.
remediation: Place behind a VPN or Zero Trust proxy.

audience_guidance.student: Admin panels are the keys to the kingdom. If they are on the internet, attackers will try to guess the password.
audience_guidance.developer: Move admin routes (e.g., /admin, /wp-admin) behind an authentication proxy or IP restriction. Enforce MFA.
audience_guidance.bug_bounty_hunter: Check for default credentials (admin/admin). Look for authorization bypasses (e.g., forced browsing).
audience_guidance.pentester: Attempt brute force. Exploit known vulnerabilities for the specific CMS/framework admin panel.
audience_guidance.security_team: Scan external perimeter for admin interfaces. Ensure they are protected by WAF and access policies.
